The following helper calls model animation processing, records the current animation frame, and invokes item-script processing.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that missing owners receive fighter notification and preserves the predicate's true-means-completion polarity.
facts.value: The pan has one item state. Its lifetime callback returns false while a non-null owner's motion ID satisfies the inclusive ftKb_MS_GwSpecialN through ftKb_MS_GwSpecialAirN range. Outside that range, or with no owner, it invokes the destruction notifier and returns true for generic item teardown. The notifier calls fighter cleanup only when owner is non-null; no general owner-pointer validity test is performed. Fighter cleanup applies guarded exit-hitlag handling before clearing the tracked pan pointer.
